$comment: AnalysisReport is an immutable parent view. Versions 1.0 and 1.1 remain exact; version 1.2 adds concise synthesis and source-code verification without removing scenario reports. Semantic validation caps each copied source-fix collection at 65,536 aggregate UTF-8 bytes because JSON Schema maxLength counts characters.

source_code.$comment: Report 1.2 state mapping is deterministic: no-source and available zero-fix outcomes are completed; executable fixes are completed when verification is either verified or explicitly not_requested.

diff.$comment: Also subject to the 65,536 UTF-8 byte aggregate synthesis-fix budget. Semantic validation parses the complete diff, requires exactly one changed .kt/.java/.xml file and one leading ---/+++ pair whose four header paths equal relative_path, rejects later file headers, .git and unsafe paths plus binary/new/delete/rename/copy/mode/symlink metadata, and intentionally does not match hunk ranges or old-lines to source.

patchArtifact.$comment: For a verified source fix, semantic validation binds size to the UTF-8 diff byte length and sha256_b64 to the SHA-256 digest of those exact bytes; mime remains exactly text/x-diff.

patchVerification.$comment: For a verified source fix, semantic validation binds patch_sha256 and the nested artifact digest metadata to the exact canonical diff bytes and binds profile_id to both fix and report validation_profile_id.

diff.$comment: Also subject to the 65,536 UTF-8 byte aggregate public-fix budget. Semantic validation parses the complete diff, requires exactly one changed .kt/.java/.xml file and one leading ---/+++ pair whose four header paths equal relative_path, rejects later file headers, .git and unsafe paths plus binary/new/delete/rename/copy/mode/symlink metadata, and intentionally does not match hunk ranges or old-lines to source.

sourceCode.$comment: Semantic validation requires source_ref_id and fix_id values to be unique; every source_refs snapshot_hash to equal snapshot.snapshot_hash; each synthesis source fix to reference existing strong refs with the same snapshot, path, symbol, linked finding/evidence, and allowed rule; source_code.fixes to be an exact ordered enrichment of synthesis source_fixes across all AI-owned fields; and every verification profile to equal both fix and report validation profiles. JSON Schema cannot compare these sibling values.
